overview_description.description:
Dubizzle Group
 is a leading digital classifieds and marketplace technology company based in Dubai, UAE. The company operates some of the most popular online platforms across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), connecting millions of users for buying, selling, renting, and property or automobile transactions.

product.name: dubizzle
product.description: An online classifieds platform in MENA for buying and selling goods and services across various categories including real estate and automobiles.

product.name: Bayut
product.description: A real estate portal in the UAE and GCC countries that connects buyers, sellers, landlords, tenants, and brokers for property transactions.

product.name: DriveArabia
product.description: An automotive consumer portal in the GCC providing car reviews, news, and information to assist buyers in making informed car purchase decisions.

product.name: Hatla2ee
product.description: An Egyptian automotive marketplace for buying and selling new and used cars, offering car evaluations, financing options, and market pricing insights.

product.name: UAE Property Monitor
product.description: A real estate market intelligence platform in the UAE providing data, analytics, and SaaS tools to support real estate professionals and developers.

product.name: Sell with AI
product.description: An AI-powered feature on dubizzle that automates and simplifies the ad posting process by suggesting categories, prices, and descriptions from uploaded images.
